overview: Create a mobile-friendly layout so users can comfortably use all features from iPhone 13, Samsung Galaxy, or tablet devices.
goals: Adapt the website layout to various screen resolutions
Ensure all features are accessible on mobile devices
successMetrics: Website renders correctly on iPhone 13, Samsung Galaxy, and common tablet sizes
All features are usable without horizontal scrolling or broken layouts
uiNotes: Collapse and reorganize elements as needed for smaller viewports. Prioritize accessibility during layout changes.
qualityGates: Verify layout renders correctly on 375px (iPhone 13), 390px (Samsung Galaxy S22), and 768px (tablet) viewports
Confirm no horizontal scrolling occurs at any supported breakpoint
Confirm all interactive elements are reachable and usable on touch devices

stories.title: Mobile Friendly Layout
stories.description: As a User, I want to be able to comfortably use all features so that I can play in my games from my iPhone 13, Samsung Galaxy, or tablet.
acceptanceCriteria: Website adapts to various resolution sizes, collapsing and reorganizing elements as needed in an accessible way
A viewport narrower than 320px or unsupported device type displays a graceful fallback or minimum usable layout without broken rendering
